content.text: Section 24 fully matches our preferred position, and no other clause creates a change-of-control exit for the Vendor.

input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets the preferred position in full: Customer may assign without Vendor consent to an Affiliate or M&A successor (24.1, with notice and assumption only); Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our consent, not unreasonably withheld, and never to a direct Customer competitor (24.2); other assignments require mutual consent on a reasonableness standard (24.3); and 24.4 expressly bars any Vendor right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service on our change of control. Section 13 (p0056) reinforces this by letting Customer transfer licence rights to an Affiliate or successor under a Section 24 permitted assignment, and no termination provision elsewhere is triggered by change of control. No redline needed.
